title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.20
subtitle: Faster UI status checks with local Wind.

highlights.title: Faster Bake status updates
highlights.description: The floating Bake button no longer captures and hashes Wind obstacle meshes during redraws or background refreshes.

highlights.title: Geometry validation stays complete
highlights.description: Obstacle edits still mark simulation geometry for validation. Full mesh checks run during explicit validation rather than UI drawing.
